purpose: Compare commit-boundary policies while holding the final code state constant.

tasks.prompt: Explain why context compression exists, what hypothesis it tests, and what evidence would accept or reject it.
Remove only the CLI exposure of compact causal history while preserving the compressor, report metrics, experiment record and tests.
Continue the context-compression work by raising the causal history limit from 12 to 20 without losing critical field recall.

invariants: All three benchmark histories must end at exactly the same tree SHA.
The replay agent receives only one isolated Git bundle whose only branch is main.
The replay agent must not receive the evaluator mapping or repository remote.
Replay results must record model/runtime identity and tool-call transcript metadata.
No aggregate winner is allowed until every treatment has the required replay count.
